chunks: And when the Book was sent to them by God verifying what had been revealed to them already even though before it they used to pray for victory over the unbelievers and even though they recognised it when it came to them, they renounced it. The curse of God be on those who deny!

key_terms.كِتَابٌ: Book (referring to the Quran or the Gospel)
key_terms.يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ: They used to pray for victory

ai.seo_question: Why did the Jews reject Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) despite knowing him from their scriptures?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Banu Qurayza and Banu Nuaym, who recognized Muhammad (PBUH) in the Torah but rejected him due to tribal rivalry with the Quraysh. It highlights the concept of 'knowing but not believing' (ma'rifah without i'tiqad), a key theme in understanding the spiritual state of the People of the Book. The verse concludes with a divine curse upon those who consciously reject the truth after recognizing it.
